scripts.build:mac: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -quiet -project DayDrop.xcodeproj -scheme DayDrop -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build
scripts.mac: npm run build:mac && npm run install:mac
scripts.test:mac: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -quiet -project DayDrop.xcodeproj -scheme DayDrop -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test
